parked.spanish: Paja no es dada a tus siervos, y ladrillos dicen a nosotros: Hagan. Y he aquí tus siervos heridos, y has pecado contra tu pueblo.

findings.issue: Spanish makes fp לִבֵנִים the grammatical subject of mp אֹמְרִים; morphology does not license the bricks as the speakers
contra has no preposition token; the link of 2ms חָטָאת to עַמֶּךָ is left open by the packet

parked.spanish: Y volvió Moisés a Jehová y dijo: Adonai, ¿por qué has hecho mal a este pueblo? ¿Por qué esto me enviaste?
Y desde entonces que vine a Faraón a hablar en tu nombre, ha hecho mal a este pueblo, y librando, no has librado a tu pueblo.

findings.issue: Spanish inserts complementizer 'que' between מֵאָז and בָּאתִי; Hebrew has no relative particle (grammatical smoothing only).

readerNotes.note: Marked the supplied copula as *es* and added 'yo' before 'oiga' to make the 1cs subject explicit, since 'oiga' alone does not distinguish yo from usted/él.

*es* is a supplied copula with no corresponding Hebrew token, and 'mucho' stays singular to agree with the singular head noun pueblo, since Spanish cannot give pueblo a plural adjective to match the Hebrew plural force of רבים.
Changed 'de ella' to 'de nosotros' to match the 1cp suffix on the preposition, and marked the supplied copula as *son*.
The copula *son* is supplied (not in the Hebrew nominal clause) and is marked in italics accordingly.

hold: clause role — whether the 1cs is the object of "enviaste" (you sent me) or esto further specifies what was sent to me is left unresolved by the morphology on h02005022012/h02005022013, so that wording is unchanged.
